# WebDost

> WebDost builds professional, mobile-first websites for Indian local businesses — gyms, salons, shops, cafes and service providers — with WhatsApp integration, Google SEO and lead-capture funnels. Launch in 7 days.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, pricing snapshot and lead-capture CTAs.
- [Services](/services): Website packages for gyms, shops, landing pages and SEO.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Sample websites we've built for local businesses.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Basic, Standard and Premium plans with feature comparison.
- [About](/about): Who we are and who we serve.
- [Contact](/contact): WhatsApp, phone, email and lead form.
